entry_metadata.title: Lunar Transient Anomalies — Zhilyaev et al. (MAO NASU)

source_claim.affiliation: Main Astronomical Observatory, National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine (MAO NASU)

claimed_phenomena.description: Stationary objects synchronized with lunar rotation, appearing anchored to surface
claimed_phenomena.behavior: Fixed position relative to Moon, pulsing luminosity

claimed_phenomena.description: Large toroidal objects in daytime sky

source_claim.authors_conclusion: The Moon serves as a base for UFOs. UFOs demonstrate intelligent behavior and can be regarded as a technologically advanced civilisation.

methodology_criticism: Significant errors in determining distances to observed objects
Miscalculations off by factor of ~10× (per Avi Loeb, Harvard)
No critical analysis of possible natural/terrestrial explanations
Unreasonable conclusions without adequate scientific rigor
Authors knowingly misrepresented work as peer-reviewed
nasu_evaluation.nasu_quote: The article is pseudo-scientific in form and content, the methods are simply full of inaccuracies, simplifications, fabrications and outright manipulations. The conclusions are mostly absurd, far-fetched and have nothing to do with simple natural explanations of observed phenomena.
nasu_evaluation.likely_explanation_2022: Artillery shells, atmospheric insects/birds, or camera noise misidentified as high-altitude craft

prior_credibility_assessment.pattern_recognition: Same structural weaknesses inherited: single-station data, no parallax distance measurements, no independent replication, signals only pixels wide.

tests.name: Centrifugal Acceleration Calculation
tests.notes: Arithmetic is correct, but physical realizability is separate question.

tests.name: Material Hoop Stress
tests.method: σ = ρ × v² for rotating ring
tests.notes: Only theoretical/exotic materials survive. No known engineered structure approaches this scale under such stress.

tests.name: Structural Mass Estimate
tests.notes: Even with most optimistic (CNT) material, ring mass = 72× all human-made structures combined.

tests.name: Orbital Mechanics & Trajectory
tests.notes: Object moving at 11 km/s near Moon is on escape trajectory. Station-keeping or surface traversal at this speed requires continuous propulsion with astronomical energy budget.

tests.name: Angular Size & Detectability
tests.notes: Claimed 35 km object would span 70,800 pixels in LRO NAC (0.5m/px). Unmistakable. 2-pixel detection implies ~1.2 km object at lunar distance, consistent with 2022 NASU finding of ~10× distance errors.

tests.name: Synchronized Flashing Statistics
tests.synchronization_precision: >60 orders of magnitude coarser than light-speed limit
tests.notes: Synchronization precision is extremely coarse. Easily explained by random coincidence, cosmic ray air showers, or satellite glints.

lro_validation.expected_detection: 70,800-pixel signature unmistakable in every frame of claimed region
lro_validation.null_result_force: LETHAL — Absence of 35 km structure in LRO data is definitive falsification

multi_site_ground_check.expected: Hundreds of professional and amateur observatories would detect 19 arcsecond objects

chandrayaan_validation.status: Not checked (redundant given LRO null result)

natural_explanation_baseline.apollo_light_flashes: Galactic cosmic rays (GCRs) interacting with retinas — confirmed by NASA
natural_explanation_baseline.transient_lunar_phenomena: Meteoroid impacts, outgassing, solar reflections — well-documented natural causes
natural_explanation_baseline.sensor_artifacts: Hot pixels, CCD readout noise, cosmic ray hits on sensor — common at detection limit
natural_explanation_baseline.atmospheric_effects: Insects, birds, dust scatter at low angular elevation — identified in 2022 NASU critique

meta_pattern_analysis.pattern_description: Dominant mode (sensor noise/atmospheric artifacts) suppressed through narrative interpretation rather than algorithmic filtering. Same archetype as C9-COLLECTION-2026-0608-SCIENCENEWS entries.

C9-2026-UAP-006_Zhilyaev.contrast: Single-source, unreproducible, physically implausible, prior methodological failure

risk_assessment.epistemic_risk: HIGH — Extraordinary claim with zero extraordinary evidence
risk_assessment.reputation_risk: MEDIUM — Prior NASU discreditation creates pattern of non-credible UAP claims
risk_assessment.resource_misallocation_risk: MEDIUM — Risk of diverting attention from legitimate anomaly detection pipelines
risk_assessment.contamination_risk: LOW — Easily identifiable as non-credible by standard filtering

recommendations.bus_integration: DO NOT integrate into primary C9 bus as live hypothesis
recommendations.use_case: Negative training example for AutoBaby v2 Hypothesis Debate Module. SKEPTIC agent should recognize pattern: small-aperture, single-observatory, high-FPS claims of massive cislunar structures without orbital cross-check = systematic failure mode.
recommendations.future_action: If peer-reviewed replication with orbital corroboration emerges, re-evaluate. Until then: quarantined.
